profileEvidence.author: C
profileEvidence.summary: Responsive Border Collies, steady Briards and inquisitive Schipperkes bring different characters to the sheepdog family. Border Collies still herd sheep and cattle, while Briards were selected to drive and guard flocks. Schipperkes add a smaller guardian branch, with a lively interest in their surroundings and a history of catching vermin.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: From responsive Border Collies to inquisitive Schipperkes, sheepdogs span herding, guarding and other working roles.
